collection.description: An elder shows a youngster how to read the changing tide.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), an elder, shows a youngster how to read the changing tide. The sea breeze carries the smell of supper being prepared.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an elder, shows a youngster how to read the changing tide. Someone offers help without being asked.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), an elder, shows a youngster how to read the changing tide. The waiting gives everyone time to talk.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), an elder, shows a youngster how to read the changing tide. (Name1) is secretly hoping the work ends before the heat rises.
